body.message: For tomorrow's viewing, we kindly ask that you arrange it between  12:00 PM and 3:00 PM  only. This will allow us to accommodate any last-minute bookings, as our guest check-in time starts from  3:00 PM . Scheduling the viewing during this time will also help avoid any cancellations. Regarding the yearly stay, we do not offer annual contracts or Ejari. However, you are welcome to stay long-term by extending your booking on a monthly basis. We can offer you the  12-month rate  if that works for you. Thank you! Kind regards, Chahana T. fäm Living
